$comment: Single source of truth for the build. Everything else is generated.
$publisher: Must match the VS Marketplace publisher id (Cursor's gallery proxies marketplace.visualstudio.com) and the Open VSX namespace if we also publish there.
$icon: Copied into each packaged extension by scripts/build.mjs. 128x128 PNG.
$engines: Lower bound is the Code OSS version inside the Cursor build this pack was reconciled against. Cursor 3.16.17 ships vscodeVersion 1.128.0. Raise it only to require a newer Cursor. `npm run detect` prints the value for the locally installed build.

pack.displayName: Cursor Language Pack — 简体中文 / 繁體中文
pack.description: Cursor IDE 中文语言包（汉化）— Simplified & Traditional Chinese for Cursor. Replaces the official VS Code language pack and translates Cursor-authored workbench strings the Microsoft pack cannot see. 替代 VS Code 官方中文语言包，并覆盖 Cursor 写进内核的界面文案。
pack.$note: Used by the single-extension `full` mode. Open VSX / Marketplace show ONE displayName + this description, so both carry the Chinese terms users search for.

target.$verifiedCursorVersions: Builds whose localizable surface this pack has been reconciled against: `npm run coverage` reports the Cursor-specific keys and `npm run validate` passes. `npm run check-upgrade` compares the installed Cursor against this list.

locales.description: Simplified Chinese for the whole Cursor IDE: the editor workbench and Cursor-authored NLS strings. Self-contained; replaces the official VS Code language pack. Cursor IDE 完整界面简体中文语言包（含编辑器主体与 Cursor 写入内核的文案），自包含，替代 VS Code 官方中文语言包。

Traditional Chinese for the whole Cursor IDE: the editor workbench and Cursor-authored NLS strings. Self-contained; replaces the official VS Code language pack. Cursor IDE 完整介面繁體中文語言包（含編輯器主體與 Cursor 寫入核心的文案），自包含，替代 VS Code 官方繁體中文語言包。

$locales: Every language microsoft/vscode-loc ships is listed here; only the enabled ones are built. To contribute a language, create src/i18n/<id>/ (see CONTRIBUTING.md) and flip `enabled` to true — no script changes needed. For a language vscode-loc does not cover, add an entry with upstreamPackDir set to null: the workbench then stays English and only the Cursor strings are translated.

full.$note: The published product. One extension declaring every enabled locale. Self-contained: vscode-loc workbench baseline plus Cursor-authored NLS keys, so it owns the `vscode` translation id. Do not install an official VS Code language pack alongside it.
full.$why: Cursor compiled its own UI into nls.messages.json (composer, agents, aiSettings, …). Those strings live in the `vscode` translation id. languagepacks.json maps one id to one file — no per-key merge. Translating them requires owning `vscode`.

companion.$note: Disabled. A companion that only claimed Cursor extension ids would coexist with the official pack, but Cursor's built-in extensions barely expose package.nls.json. Almost all reachable Cursor strings live in the `vscode` id.

upstream.$ref: Last vscode-loc commit still on engine 1.128.0, immediately before the 1.129.0 bump. Pin here so File/Edit/View stay aligned with Cursor 3.16.17 (Code OSS 1.128.0). Do not track vscode-loc main.
upstream.$license: vscode-loc source and strings are MIT licensed, so redistribution is permitted. See NOTICE.

build.$filterByCursorMetadata: Drop keys that do not exist in the local Cursor build. Shrinks the pack and makes coverage numbers meaningful. Automatically disabled when metadata/ is absent (e.g. in CI).
build.$repairMismatchedMarkers: Drop inherited translations whose {0} placeholders, $(icon) references or (command:...) links no longer match the English source in the installed Cursor build. Mismatches in files this repository maintains are reported instead of dropped. Requires metadata/.
